notes: Ruka 0.3.98: tree-sitter AST merge and stronger parallel-editor recovery. Adds tree-sitter WASM parsing for TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, C/C++, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Ruby, PHP, CSS, HTML, JSON, YAML, TOML and Vue, with declaration fallback. Conflict resolution retries twice, patch tasks can retry with the model, and the model benchmark now supports up to six real tasks. The update channel defaults new profiles to the working GitHub Pages mirror while retaining the custom-server and raw fallbacks.
